name: redact-pdf-mcp
description: Permanently redact PII from PDFs and scans. EU/Swiss-hosted, never used to train AI models.
long_description:
An MCP server that permanently redacts PII from PDFs, photos and screenshots. The sensitive text is deleted from the file rather than covered with a black rectangle, so it cannot be recovered by copy-paste, text extraction, or "remove object" in a PDF editor.

Most MCP "redaction" servers scrub PII out of prompt text. This one takes a real document and returns a real redacted document.

Includes a keyless try_demo tool, so an agent can verify the server works before any API key is configured. Handles scanned documents via OCR across 100+ languages and detects 8 entity types. Documents are processed on Microsoft Azure in the EU and Switzerland, encrypted in transit and at rest, never used to train AI models, and the original is deleted after processing. The server itself is stateless and sends no telemetry.

tools.name: redact_pdf_and_wait
tools.description: Redact a PDF, photo or screenshot and return the redacted PDF in one call. The sensitive text is removed from the file, not covered.

tools.name: redact_pdf
tools.description: Start a redaction job without waiting, for redacting several documents in parallel.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check the progress of a redaction job.

tools.name: download_redacted
tools.description: Download the finished redacted PDF for one document.

tools.name: try_demo
tools.description: No API key needed: redact the first page of your own file, or run a built-in sample.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Check that the API key is valid and see the account it belongs to.

prompts.name: redact_before_sending
prompts.description: Redact personal data in one document before sharing it.
prompts.text: Redact the personal data in ${arguments.file_path} and save the redacted PDF next to it.

prompts.name: redact_folder_keep_company
prompts.description: Redact a folder of PDFs while keeping your company name visible.
prompts.text: Redact names, email addresses, phone numbers and IBANs in every PDF in ${arguments.folder}. Keep ${arguments.company_name} visible.

prompts.name: try_on_my_file
prompts.description: See what the redaction does on your own file, with no API key.
prompts.text: Use the redact-pdf try_demo tool on ${arguments.file_path} and tell me what it found on the first page.

api_key.title: Redact PDF AI API key
api_key.description: Your API key from redact-pdf.ai. Optional: without one, the keyless try_demo tool still works (it redacts the first page of a real file) so you can see output before signing up. A free account gets its first document, up to 5 pages, redacted in full with no card.
